name: agent-output-evaluation-and-benchmark-harness
title: agent output evaluation and benchmark harness
description: Build an offline benchmark harness that runs a fixed set of golden tasks, scores the agent output, and tracks score/cost regressions across model & prompt changes. PR1: pure-logic foundation (golden fixtures + scorer registry); PR2: runner + persistence; PR3: API + async job; PR4: frontend Benchmarks page.
creator: jackmouse

subtasks.title: PR4: frontend Benchmarks page (trigger / leaderboard / score×cost / baseline diff) + i18n
subtasks.notes: Done (commit 36a8a8c). frontend/src/lib/types.ts + api.ts (8 typed fetchers); frontend/src/features/benchmarks/helpers.ts (pure: fmtUsd / fmtPassAt1 / classifyDelta / summarizeDiff / projectPoints / pickLogTicks / roundTick); BenchmarksPage.tsx (TriggerForm / Leaderboard / ScoreCostFrontier hand-rolled SVG / RunDiffPanel / CalibrationPanel + useBenchmarkJob polling hook); app/benchmarks/page.tsx (tabbed: leaderboard / frontier / diff / calibration; auto-refresh on job complete); 70 new i18n keys × 2 locales. 16 new helper tests, 151/151 frontend suite, lint clean, build green.

subtasks.title: PR3: API endpoints + async job + LLM-as-judge + calibration set
subtasks.notes: Done (commit c39e0d2). 4 new modules: judge.py (LLMJudgeScorer + FixedResponseBackend + JudgeBackend Protocol, strict first-line parser, uncalibrated never passes), correlation.py (Pearson + Spearman + CalibrationSet round-trip, total-set n in the report), calibration/ (8 hand-labeled PM-artifact items covering gold/ambiguous/underspecified/over-specific/refactor/excellent/misleading/specific extremes), job.py (in-memory JobRegistry + start_job helper, async on_complete correctly awaited), api.py (handler bodies + module singletons; TriggerRunRequest validates epochs >= 1 at the parse layer). 8 new routes wired into app/interfaces/api.py (POST runs 202, GET runs/{id}, GET runs, GET runs/{id}/diff, GET/POST baseline, GET jobs/{id}, GET calibration). Wired into app/main.py lifespan (init_for_app at startup, non-fatal if benchmark init fails). 45 new unit tests (24 judge + correlation, 21 API). 747/747 full backend suite, 0 regressions.

subtasks.title: PR4: frontend Benchmarks page (trigger / leaderboard / score×cost / baseline diff) + i18n
subtasks.notes: Leaderboard grouped by difficulty/tag; score×cost frontier chart; baseline-vs-candidate diff; zh/en copy.
